priorityList: Keep Demon Spikes active as much as possible while in combat.
Use offensive trinkets and potions during Metamorphosis or when execute is active.
Apply Fiery Brand to maintain the Fiery Demise buff, especially before high-damage sequences.
Cast Metamorphosis when ready, ideally after consuming 3+ Soul Fragments with Spirit Bomb.
Cast Fel Devastation on cooldown to trigger or extend Metamorphosis and Fel-Scarred buffs.
Use Soul Carver if you have 3 or fewer Soul Fragments to maximize generation.
Cast Sigil of Spite if you have 2 or fewer Soul Fragments.
During the Voidfall spending buff, prioritize Soul Cleave as your main spender.
Cast Spirit Bomb when you have 4 or more Soul Fragments (or 3+ if Fiery Demise is active).
Use Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and extend Fiery Brand via Charred Flesh.
Use Fracture if you are about to cap charges or if you need Soul Fragments for Spirit Bomb.
Use Felblade as a filler to generate Fury and close gaps.
Cast Sigil of Flame as a filler for additional damage and generation.
Use Soul Cleave as a secondary spender if you have excess Fury and are not at high Soul Fragments.
Use Throw Glaive as a last resort filler when no other abilities are available.
